links.comparator_used: Two purpose-specific threshold sets compared with each other: one optimized for PPV (F-score 0.5) and one for sensitivity (F-score 2). No fixed vendor default was tested.
links.outcome: Detected postoperative complication counts and rates, and hospital-level comparisons
links.effect: The NLP models detected 8,512 PCs (9.14%) with the PPV-optimized thresholds and 15,892 PCs (17.1%) with the sensitivity-optimized thresholds. Trends over time were mostly stable or increasing under both settings. Threshold selection significantly influenced the regression findings.
links.tradeoff: Neither setting is better overall. The choice of threshold changes the observed complication rates and hospital rankings, so it has to match the surveillance purpose and be reported with PPV-sensitivity curves.
links.quote: Regression analyses demonstrated that threshold se-lection significantly influenced findings, impacting hospital comparisons.

design_hint: alert threshold selection (F-score optimization for PPV vs sensitivity)
